findingDetails.title: The empty-hash sentinel still hides a baseline path the lane recreates
findingDetails.evidence: detectNewOutOfScopeViolations skips every baseline path whose recorded hash is empty (`const preHash = preMap.get(p) || ''; if (!preHash) continue;`). The snapshot stores hash:'' for any path git hash-object cannot read, including a tracked path deleted before dispatch, because gitHashObject returns '' on a non-zero exit (write-containment.ts:506-510). The phase-009 addition (:930-953) walks the subtraction the other way only for entries marked untracked whose path is absent from status AND absent from disk (:936-938, :944), so a lane that recreates the path is excluded by construction. The only test pins the subtraction case (tests/unit/write-containment.vitest.ts:535-554); no case covers recreation.
findingDetails.recommendation: Give unhashable-but-recorded baseline paths a distinct absent state and re-evaluate them with the content-identity check when they reappear, instead of storing '' and treating it as unmatched forever.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the full detection path, the snapshot writer and gitHashObject; read the phase-009 deletion tests and grepped for a recreation case (none).

findingDetails.title: A containment pass whose quarantine evidence failed to write is indistinguishable from a complete one
findingDetails.evidence: enforceWriteContainment returns the full QuarantineResult {dirPath, entries, refused, error} (write-containment.ts:1331-1354), but buildContainmentViolationEvent carries only violations, reverted, the patch path and dataLossPossible; the runner appends that event (fanout-run.cjs:3526-3544) and keeps only quarantinePath for output.containment (:3649-3652), dropping refused and error. For a lane that fails a gate, even quarantinePath is discarded with the thrown error (:3585-3626). A pass whose manifest failed, or whose destinations the phase-008 canonicality check refused, therefore reads exactly like a complete pass wherever the violation is reported.
findingDetails.recommendation: Carry {dirPath, refused, error} on the containment event (or on output.containment for failed lanes too) so an incomplete quarantine record is visible next to the violation it belongs to.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the enforce return contract, the event builder, and both runner consumers (successful and failed lane paths); grepped the event type for quarantine fields (none).

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Path handling, persistence and shared policy surfaces: the review contract's security-sensitive override applies and a second full pass is required before a legal STOP.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Every phase-008/009/011/012 change lands in the guard module; the runner owns the containment call site and the ledger event.
